threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the office desktops, including the dispatch desk, and the synced shared drive; dispatch falls back to paper
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; signature antivirus with business-hours alerting only; desktop sync would carry encrypted files into the suite and the backup; manual dispatch never practiced
existing_controls: MFA on email; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: Annual training and quarterly phishing simulations; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alert monitoring; 90-day immutable backup versions; nightly printed run sheet and quarterly manual dispatch drill

threat_event: Stolen or guessed password used to sign in to the operations platform and export trip and patient records (breach of up to about 5,200 patients)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the platform for any user; shared dispatch password unchanged since 2024 and known to former schedulers; export log never reviewed
existing_controls: Unique ePCR logins; vendor lockout after failed sign-ins
treatment_plan: Shared dispatch password changed 2026-09-08 and weekly export log check; MFA for every platform user and named dispatch accounts by 2026-10-31; monthly access review

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every office computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access to all office computers; no review of MSP security practices or technician list
existing_controls: BAA with the MSP; MSP states it uses MFA on its console (not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire and evidence of MFA, technician list, subcontractors); 24-hour incident notice and an after-hours line in the contract renewal

threat_event: Hosted phone and fax vendor stores call recordings and faxed certification statements without a BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA never requested; recordings kept indefinitely by default
existing_controls: Vendor encrypts stored recordings (vendor documentation)
treatment_plan: BAA signed 2026-08-21 (done); recording retention set to 2 years on 2026-08-28 (done)

threat_event: Shared drive and mailbox data cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or sync of damaged files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup keeps 30 days of versions; never restore-tested; one MSP administrator account without MFA can delete versions
existing_controls: Nightly copy by the backup service
treatment_plan: First restore test by the MSP; MFA on the backup console; 90-day immutable versions; quarterly restore tests recorded

threat_event: Former EMT or scheduler signs in to the platform after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination step; part-time turnover; two former EMT ePCR accounts found active (disabled 2026-07-29); shared dispatch password not changed at departures
existing_controls: Unique ePCR logins
treatment_plan: Termination checklist on the last day (platform, facility portal, suite, phone, devices); shared password retired with named accounts; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Misuse of the dispatch board cannot be traced to a person because of the shared dispatch login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared dispatch account with administrator role used by 3 staff and the on-call phone
existing_controls: Platform logs actions to the shared account
treatment_plan: Named dispatch accounts with quick sign-in; remove the administrator role from day-to-day accounts

threat_event: Operations platform outage lasts longer than the 2-hour dispatch RTO and manual dispatch fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 4 h is longer than the BP-02 RTO; run sheet printed only most nights; manual dispatch never practiced
existing_controls: Vendor replication; crew phones
treatment_plan: Run sheet printed every night and kept in the dispatch binder and the on-call bag; quarterly manual dispatch drill; vendor RTO in the contract at renewal

threat_event: Office internet outage stops intake and dispatch at the desk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One cable internet line; no failover router
existing_controls: Crew phones and vehicle hotspots on a cellular carrier
treatment_plan: Cellular failover router at the office; on-call phone hotspot as a stopgap; forwarding test

threat_event: Lost or stolen tablet or company phone exposes PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices travel in ambulances and with on-call staff; one crew phone was left at a hospital in 2025
existing_controls: MDM encryption, passcode, 2-minute lock, and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted devices consistent with HHS guidance hold no unsecured PHI (45 CFR 164.402); residual risk Low

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted office desktop during a burglary exposes cached PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 desktops unencrypted; synced shared drive files and downloaded trip reports stored locally
existing_controls: Keyed entry and alarm
treatment_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on both desktops and reports status monthly

threat_event: Certification statements missing, out of date, or lost, leading to Medicare overpayment findings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PCS arrive by fax, portal, and paper; paper kept in a binder; no 7-year retention rule; 3 of 20 dialysis trips sampled lacked a current PCS
existing_controls: Office Manager attaches most PCS to the trip in the platform
treatment_plan: Attach every PCS to the trip before release to billing; 60-day expiry alert for repetitive patients; scan the paper binder; 7-year retention rule in POL-04

threat_event: AI intake vendor uses recorded calls to train or improve its models, outside the BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature switched on under terms allowing model improvement use; BAA coverage of the AI subprocessor unconfirmed
existing_controls: Pilot limited to one user
treatment_plan: Written confirmation that the BAA covers the AI feature, with no-training terms and 30-day deletion; stop the feature if not received (see P10)

threat_event: AI intake assistant misses a caller's description of an emergency or suggests too low a level of service, and the patient waits for a scheduled BLS unit instead of 911
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Advisory suggestions shown to the Scheduler-Dispatcher since 2026-06-01 with no accuracy testing; emergency flag accuracy unknown for Spanish-speaking callers
regulatory_driver: 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool); C-EMERGENCY-R04
existing_controls: Scheduler-Dispatcher reads every request; Medical Director's 911 redirect card at the desk
treatment_plan: Emergency flag shown as a prompt only, never as a clearance; redirect card is the decision of record; monthly review of 20 calls by the Medical Director (see P10)

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident, so breach clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan before 2026-09-04; training only at hire; 2025 lost phone and misdirected fax never logged
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting card in each ambulance and at the dispatch desk; annual training; tabletop exercise

threat_event: An incident or outage before 7:00 a.m. or on a weekend waits for technical help while dialysis runs are under way
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP contract covers weekdays 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. only; dialysis pickups start at 5:00 a.m.; no after-hours line
existing_controls: Owner or Office Manager can be reached by phone
treatment_plan: After-hours emergency line in the MSP contract renewal; cyber insurer hotline (24x7) in the runbook; owner laptop kept ready as a clean dispatch device

threat_event: Face sheet or trip packet faxed or emailed to the wrong facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No verification step for new fax numbers; facility contacts not saved
existing_controls: Fax cover sheet
treatment_plan: Saved contacts for each facility; read-back rule for new numbers; covered in annual training

threat_event: Attacker reaches office computers through the shared Wi-Fi or an unmanaged vehicle hotspot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office computers share Wi-Fi with crew personal phones; password unchanged since 2022; hotspot firmware not updated since 2022 and on no inventory
existing_controls: Firewall blocks inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Separate staff and guest Wi-Fi; yearly password change; hotspots added to the inventory and to MSP management

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office and garage while dialysis patients still need transport
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan or alternate site; one office and garage
existing_controls: Platform reachable from any device; crew phones
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: printed dialysis list, owner laptop and on-call phone as the mobile dispatch kit, vehicles fueled and staged, facility notice script

threat_event: Billing company breach or outage exposes or delays claims
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security review of the billing company; no SOC 2 report offered; contract has no breach notice period
existing_controls: BAA on file; MFA on the billing portal
treatment_plan: Annual security questionnaire with evidence; breach notice within 10 days in the contract (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) applies to third-party agents)

threat_event: OCR enforcement after a complaint or breach because no risk analysis or policies existed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: First risk analysis in 2026; no adopted policies before 2026-09-04; no inventory
existing_controls: 2026 risk analysis (this register)
treatment_plan: Adopt P06 policies; yearly risk analysis update; device and ePHI inventory

threat_event: Workforce member looks up a neighbor's or acquaintance's trip record without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No access report review; small community; shared dispatch account hides who looked
existing_controls: Role-based access
treatment_plan: Monthly access report review; sanctions rule in POL-02; named dispatch accounts (R-007)

threat_event: Attacker uses the unmanaged remote desktop tool on the dispatch desktop to reach the platform session and office files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free remote desktop tool installed in 2025 outside MSP management, with a reused password (found in P07 testing 2026-08-18; removed 2026-08-19)
existing_controls: Removed 2026-08-19; tool's connection log showed no unknown sessions in its 90-day history
treatment_plan: Approved software list enforced by the MSP; monthly MSP report of new software; EDR (R-001)

threat_event: Request calls recorded without the consent the law requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No recorded announcement until 2026-08-25; the company is not a public safety answering point, so it relies on all-party consent
existing_controls: Announcement added 2026-08-25
treatment_plan: Counsel confirms the announcement wording; announcement on every recorded line, including after-hours forwarding
